**I. Preparation & Initial Records (Building from #1)**

* **Review Vehicle History:** Before starting the brake test, review the vehicle’s maintenance history (if available). Look for any prior brake work, reported issues, or relevant recalls. This provides context. Note this in the "Comments" section of the report.
* **Confirm Inspection Standards:**  Know *exactly* what the acceptable standards are for brake performance in your jurisdiction. This is vital. Refer to the official inspection manual or regulations
